description: We are a small team of young developers, all of whom desire to create an interactive map that helps astronauts explore, navigate, and simulate missions on Mars using real NASA data. Unfortunately, we're not scientists, but we can happily say that we're curious, a little chaotic, and, last but not least, utterly motivated to deliver something cool in 48 hours fueled by caffeine, bad jokes, and a completely functional prototype that actually works on our planet. By planet, of course, we mean Mars.
